title.zh: 卷439 列傳二百二十六 景廉 额勒和布 许庚身 钱应溥 廖寿恒 荣庆 那桐 戴鸿慈
title.en: Volume 439 Biographies 226: Jing Lian, E Lei He Bu, Xu Gengshen, Qian Yingpu, Liao Shouheng, Rong Qing, Na Tong, Dai Hongci
title.raw: 卷439 列傳二百二十六 景廉 额勒和布 许庚身 钱应溥 廖寿恒 荣庆 那桐 戴鸿慈

sentences.zh: 列傳二百二十六

translations.literal: Biographies 226
translations.idiomatic: Biography 226

sentences.zh: 景廉額勒和布許庚身錢應溥廖壽恆

translations.literal: Jing Lian, E Lei He Bu, Xu Gengshen, Qian Yingpu, Liao Shouheng
translations.idiomatic: Jing Lian, E Lei He Bu, Xu Gengshen, Qian Yingpu, and Liao Shouheng

sentences.zh: 榮慶那桐戴鴻慈

translations.literal: Rong Qing, Na Tong, Dai Hongci
translations.idiomatic: Rong Qing, Na Tong, and Dai Hongci

sentences.zh: 景廉，字秋坪，顏札氏，隸滿洲正黃旗。

translations.literal: Jing Lian, style name Qiuping, of the Yan Zha clan, belonged to the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Lian, whose style name was Qiuping, was of the Yan Zha clan and served in the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 父彥德，官綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: His father Yande served as General of Suiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: His father Yande had held the post of General of Suiyuan.

sentences.zh: 景廉，咸豐二年進士，由編修五遷至內閣學士。

translations.literal: Jing Lian passed the jinshi examination in the second year of Xianfeng and was promoted five times from Compiler to Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Lian became a jinshi in the second year of the Xianfeng reign and rose through five promotions from Compiler to Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 典福建鄉試，擢工部侍郎，賜奠朝鮮。

translations.literal: He presided over the Fujian provincial examination, was promoted to Vice Minister of Works, and was granted the mission to offer sacrifices in Korea.
translations.idiomatic: He served as chief examiner for the Fujian provincial examination, was promoted to Vice Minister of Works, and was sent to offer sacrificial rites in Korea.

sentences.zh: 八年，授伊犁參贊大臣。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he was appointed Assistant Resident at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of the reign, he was appointed Assistant Resident at Ili.

sentences.zh: 故事，哈薩克貿易訖即行。

translations.literal: By precedent, Kazakh traders were to depart as soon as trade ended.
translations.idiomatic: By established practice, Kazakh traders were required to leave as soon as their business was concluded.

sentences.zh: 後以貨滯鬻，許二三人守以度歲，漸成聚落，週二里許。

translations.literal: Later, because goods sold slowly, two or three men were allowed to remain over the winter; gradually a settlement formed, about two li in circumference.
translations.idiomatic: Later, because merchandise moved slowly, two or three men were permitted to stay through the winter to guard unsold stock; a settlement gradually took shape, roughly two li around.

sentences.zh: 景廉謂禍伏肘腋，毀之便，將軍憚不敢發。

translations.literal: Jing Lian said disaster lurked at the elbow and armpit and that destroying it would be best, but the general feared to act.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Lian warned that trouble was brewing close at hand and urged that the settlement be destroyed, but the general was afraid to take action.

sentences.zh: 會將軍卒，景廉攝任，疏陳利害，請以便宜從事，卒毀之。

translations.literal: When the general died, Jing Lian acted in his stead, memorialized on the advantages and harms, requested discretionary authority, and finally destroyed it.
translations.idiomatic: When the general died, Jing Lian assumed his duties, submitted a memorial setting out the risks and benefits, asked for authority to act as circumstances required, and in the end had the settlement destroyed.

sentences.zh: 詔下，如所請。

translations.literal: An edict was issued approving his request.
translations.idiomatic: The court issued an edict granting what he had requested.

sentences.zh: 塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣英秀、阿克蘇辦事大臣綿性、葉爾羌參贊大臣英蘊先後以貪暴被劾，皆命景廉往鞫，得實，降革有差。

translations.literal: The Assistant Residents Ying Xiu at Tarbagatai, Mian Xing at Aksu, and Ying Yun at Yarkand were successively impeached for greed and cruelty; all were ordered investigated by Jing Lian; the charges were substantiated and demotions and dismissals were imposed in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Residents Ying Xiu at Tarbagatai, Mian Xing at Aksu, and Ying Yun at Yarkand were impeached one after another for corruption and brutality; Jing Lian was sent to investigate each case, found the accusations true, and the offenders were demoted or dismissed to varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 十一年，調葉爾羌參贊大臣，其城為南路八城之首，漢、回雜處。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was transferred to Yarkand as Assistant Resident; that city was the chief of the eight southern cities, with Han and Hui living together.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was transferred to serve as Assistant Resident at Yarkand, the leading city among the eight southern towns, where Han Chinese and Muslims lived side by side.

sentences.zh: 安集延常擾邊，俄人復於西南徼往來窺伺，哈薩克各部落多貳於俄。

translations.literal: Kokand often harassed the border; Russians also came and went along the southwestern frontier to spy; many Kazakh tribes leaned toward Russia.
translations.idiomatic: Kokand frequently raided the frontier, while Russians prowled the southwestern marches, and many Kazakh tribes were divided in loyalty toward Russia.

sentences.zh: 景廉籌餉練兵，持以鎮靜，八城以安。

translations.literal: Jing Lian raised funds and trained troops, maintained calm, and the eight cities were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Lian raised revenue, drilled troops, and governed with steady composure until all eight cities were secure.

sentences.zh: 嚴禁綠營兵以重利侵奪回民貲產，人心大悅。

translations.literal: He strictly forbade Green Standard troops from seizing Muslim property for heavy profit, and the people were greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: He strictly forbade Green Standard soldiers from extorting Muslim property for profit, to the great satisfaction of the populace.

sentences.zh: 同治二年，坐事落職，男婦數千哭於札爾瑪。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi he was dismissed for an offense; thousands of men and women wept at the Zharma shrine.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tongzhi he lost his post after being implicated in a case; thousands of men and women gathered weeping at the Zharma shrine.

sentences.zh: 札爾瑪者，回部棲神之所，意欲禱神阻其行也。

translations.literal: Zharma was a place where the Muslims housed their gods; they intended to pray to the gods to block his departure.
translations.idiomatic: Zharma was a Muslim shrine where deities were housed; the mourners hoped by prayer to keep him from leaving.

sentences.zh: 景廉既去官，遣往寧夏軍營效力，將軍都興阿檄參戎幕。

translations.literal: After Jing Lian left office he was sent to serve at the Ningxia camp; General Du Xing'a summoned him to the military staff.
translations.idiomatic: Stripped of office, Jing Lian was sent to serve at the Ningxia army camp, where General Du Xing'a called him into his staff.

sentences.zh: 適安徽巡撫翁同書卒於軍，复檄景廉代領其眾，防剿後路。

translations.literal: When Anhui Governor Weng Tonghe died in camp, he again ordered Jing Lian to take command of his forces and guard and suppress the rear routes.
translations.idiomatic: When Anhui Governor Weng Tonghe died in the field, Du Xing'a again ordered Jing Lian to take over his troops and secure the rear against enemy raids.

sentences.zh: 五年，授頭等侍衛，充哈密幫辦大臣。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was made a First Class Bodyguard and appointed Assistant at Hami.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was appointed First Class Bodyguard and Assistant Commissioner at Hami.

sentences.zh: 募勇千餘，騎不滿百，糧乏，冰雪中僵僕相屬。

translations.literal: He recruited over a thousand braves; cavalry numbered fewer than a hundred; provisions were scarce, and in ice and snow servants froze one after another.
translations.idiomatic: He raised more than a thousand militiamen but had fewer than a hundred horses and scant grain; in the ice and snow his attendants froze to death in succession.

sentences.zh: 景廉勉以忠義，夜支單帳，燃馬矢，席地坐，時出撫循，以是兵心固結。

translations.literal: Jing Lian exhorted them with loyalty and righteousness, at night pitched a single tent, burned horse dung for warmth, sat on the ground, and went out from time to time to comfort them; thus troop morale was firmly united.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Lian urged loyalty and duty on his men, slept under a single tent at night, warmed himself with burning horse dung, sat on the bare ground, and went out regularly to encourage the troops, so that their morale held firm.

sentences.zh: 肅州賊沿南山西竄，景廉遣總兵張玉春敗之黃花營。

translations.literal: Rebels from Suzhou fled westward along the southern mountains; Jing Lian sent Brigadier Zhang Yuchun to defeat them at Huanghuaying.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels from Suzhou fled west along the southern mountains; Jing Lian sent Brigadier Zhang Yuchun to rout them at Huanghuaying.

sentences.zh: 賊擾​​安西州，又大敗之。

translations.literal: The rebels harassed Anxi Prefecture and were again heavily defeated.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels raided Anxi Prefecture, he defeated them again.

sentences.zh: 景廉以安西玉門為新疆門戶，巴里坤雖天險可守，然力單不足恃，疏請駐安西，佈置防務輓運，得旨報可。

translations.literal: Jing Lian held that Anxi and Yumen were the gateway to Xinjiang; though Barkol was a natural fortress, his forces were too few to rely on it; he memorialized to station himself at Anxi and arrange defenses and transport; the throne approved.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Lian argued that Anxi and Yumen were the gateway to Xinjiang and that, although Barkol was a natural fortress, his forces were too weak to hold it alone; he memorialized to base himself at Anxi and organize defenses and supply lines, and the court approved.

sentences.zh: 賊撲敦煌，景廉陽令副將蔣富山邀擊南乾溝，而伏勁旅橋灣三水梁。

translations.literal: Rebels struck Dunhuang; Jing Lian openly ordered Deputy Commander Jiang Fushan to intercept them at Nangan Gully while secretly posting elite troops at Qiaowan Sanshui Liang.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels attacked Dunhuang, Jing Lian openly ordered Deputy Commander Jiang Fushan to meet them at Nangan Gully while secretly placing elite troops in ambush at Qiaowan Sanshui Liang.

sentences.zh: 賊果取道三水梁南戈壁，伏起，追擊敗之。

translations.literal: The rebels indeed took the southern Gobi route past Sanshui Liang; the ambush rose, pursued, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels took the southern Gobi route past Sanshui Liang as expected; the ambush sprang up, pursued them, and won a decisive victory.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，得旨嘉獎。

translations.literal: News of victory arrived and he received an edict of commendation.
translations.idiomatic: When word of the victory reached the capital, the throne issued a commendatory edict.

sentences.zh: 賊复撲安西，景廉戒守將堅壁毋浪戰，伺其懈擊之，而設伏要其歸路，賊大創，遁。

translations.literal: The rebels again struck Anxi; Jing Lian warned the defenders to hold the walls and not fight rashly, wait for their slackness to strike, and set ambushes on their retreat; the rebels were heavily wounded and fled.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels struck Anxi again, Jing Lian ordered the garrison to hold the walls and avoid reckless sorties, to strike when the enemy grew careless, and to lay ambushes on their line of retreat; the rebels suffered heavy losses and fled.

sentences.zh: 景廉謂敦煌重鎮，當守以重兵，因移鎮敦煌，留兵安西、玉門相犄角。

translations.literal: Jing Lian said Dunhuang was a vital post and should be held with heavy troops; he therefore moved his headquarters there and left forces at Anxi and Yumen in mutual support.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Lian judged Dunhuang a strategic strongpoint that required a substantial garrison, moved his headquarters there, and stationed troops at Anxi and Yumen so the three posts could support one another.

sentences.zh: 建堅壁清野之計，完城浚壕，擇要區築空心墩台，守具畢備。

translations.literal: He adopted a policy of strengthening walls and clearing the countryside, repaired the city and deepened the moat, chose key points to build hollow watch towers, and completed all defensive equipment.
translations.idiomatic: He implemented a scorched-earth defense: repaired the walls, deepened the moats, built hollow watch towers at key points, and fully equipped the garrisons.

sentences.zh: 復以商團民練輔翼官兵，隱寓保甲之法，賊擄掠之計遂沮。

translations.literal: He further used merchant militia and civilian levies to support the regular troops, implicitly applying the baojia system, and the rebels' plans for plunder were thwarted.
translations.idiomatic: He also organized merchant militias and local levies to support the regular troops along baojia lines, thwarting the rebels' plans for looting.

sentences.zh: 招徠土著三千六百餘戶，勸募雜糧二萬餘石，立轉運局馬蓮井，官民咸稱便焉。

translations.literal: He induced over 3,600 native households to return, encouraged the collection of more than 20,000 shi of miscellaneous grain, and established a transport bureau at Malianjing; officials and people alike praised the convenience.
translations.idiomatic: He brought back more than 3,600 native households, encouraged the donation of over 20,000 shi of grain, and set up a transport bureau at Malianjing, which officials and civilians alike found highly convenient.

sentences.zh: 時烏魯木齊回酋妥得璘勾結漢、回、纏頭萬八千餘東犯，潛約哈密回子郡王為內應。

translations.literal: At that time the Urumqi Muslim leader Tuo De Lin united more than eighteen thousand Han, Hui, and Turki to invade eastward and secretly arranged the Hami Muslim prince as an inside collaborator.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Urumqi Muslim leader Tuo De Lin rallied more than eighteen thousand Han, Hui, and Turki fighters for an eastern invasion and secretly enlisted the Hami Muslim prince as an inside collaborator.

sentences.zh: 王素騃，其母福晉邁哩巴紐賢明有才略，以逆書呈官軍，誓效力守。

translations.literal: The prince was simple-minded; his mother, the fujin Maili Banu, was wise and capable; she presented the rebel letter to the government army and vowed to serve in defense.
translations.idiomatic: The prince was naive, but his mother, the fujin Maili Banu, was intelligent and resourceful; she turned the rebel correspondence over to the government forces and pledged to hold Hami loyal.

sentences.zh: 景廉遣使獎慰，復令富山率兵會辦事大臣文麟、裨將孔才擊賊，連戰六晝夜，大敗之。

translations.literal: Jing Lian sent envoys to reward and comfort them, then ordered Fushan to lead troops to join Commissioner Wen Lin and Lieutenant Kong Cai to attack the rebels; after six days and nights of continuous fighting they were heavily defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Lian sent envoys with rewards and encouragement, then ordered Fushan to join Commissioner Wen Lin and Lieutenant Kong Cai in attacking the rebels; after six days and nights of fighting they won a crushing victory.

sentences.zh: 論功，升擢有差。

translations.literal: Merits were assessed and promotions were granted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards for merit were distributed and the officers were promoted in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 旋授烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: He was soon appointed General at Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed General Commandant at Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 時古牧地偽元帥馬明屢詐言降，复假貿易分佈逆黨於濟木薩、木壘河。

translations.literal: At that time the false marshal Ma Ming at Gucheng repeatedly feigned surrender while using trade to spread rebel agents through Jimsar and the Mulei River region.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the rebel commander Ma Ming at Gucheng repeatedly feigned surrender while using trade as cover to spread rebel agents through Jimsar and along the Mulei River.

sentences.zh: 景廉偵知，密檄孔才、金永清等一夕殲之。

translations.literal: Jing Lian detected this and secretly ordered Kong Cai, Jin Yongqing, and others to annihilate them in one night.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Lian uncovered the plot and secretly ordered Kong Cai, Jin Yongqing, and others to wipe them out in a single night.

sentences.zh: 俄人挾蒙古、哈薩克入境求通商，景廉言地方未靖，不任保護，以兵衛之出。

translations.literal: Russians brought Mongols and Kazakhs across the border seeking trade; Jing Lian said the region was not yet pacified and he could not guarantee protection, and had troops escort them out.
translations.idiomatic: Russians brought Mongols and Kazakhs across the border to seek trade; Jing Lian replied that the region was still unsettled and he could not guarantee their safety, and had troops escort them back out.

sentences.zh: 自是終景廉任，俄人不言通商事。

translations.literal: From then until the end of Jing Lian's tenure, Russians no longer raised the matter of trade.
translations.idiomatic: For the remainder of Jing Lian's tenure, the Russians did not raise trade again.

sentences.zh: 穆宗親政，景廉以為政治在乎始基，上崇正學、開言路、慎牧令、簡軍實、重農桑、弭異端六事。

translations.literal: When the Muzong Emperor took personal rule, Jing Lian held that government lies in its foundations and submitted six proposals: honor orthodox learning, open channels of remonstrance, choose magistrates carefully, streamline military strength, emphasize agriculture and sericulture, and suppress heterodox teachings.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tongzhi Emperor assumed personal rule, Jing Lian argued that sound government depends on laying the right foundations and submitted six proposals: promote orthodox learning, open channels of remonstrance, appoint magistrates with care, streamline military forces, emphasize agriculture and sericulture, and suppress heterodox teachings.

sentences.zh: 移軍古城，疏請以副都統吉爾洪額、領隊大臣沙克都林札布任軍事。

translations.literal: He moved his army to Gucheng and memorialized to assign military affairs to Vice Commander Jir Hong'e and Brigade Commander Shakudulin Zhabu.
translations.idiomatic: He shifted his headquarters to Gucheng and memorialized to place military operations under Vice Commander Jir Hong'e and Brigade Commander Shakudulin Zhabu.

sentences.zh: 陝回白彥虎糾西寧回萬餘，將奔烏魯木齊，賊勢梟悍，破哈密回城，遊騎越天山，擾巴里坤，兩城告急。

translations.literal: The Shaanxi Muslim Bai Yanhu rallied more than ten thousand Xining Muslims to rush toward Urumqi; the rebels were fierce as owls and hawks; they broke the Hami Muslim city, scouting cavalry crossed the Tianshan, harassed Barkol, and both cities sent urgent alarms.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaanxi Muslim rebel Bai Yanhu rallied more than ten thousand Xining Muslims to march on Urumqi; the rebels were ferocious, seized the Muslim quarter of Hami, sent scouting parties across the Tianshan to harass Barkol, and both cities sent urgent appeals for help.

sentences.zh: 會妥得璘死，安集延酋帕夏合烏魯木齊、古牧地等漢、回撲沙山子，遙應白彥虎。

translations.literal: When Tuo De Lin died, the Kokand leader Pasha united Han and Hui from Urumqi, Gucheng, and elsewhere to strike Shashanzi, coordinating from afar with Bai Yanhu.
translations.idiomatic: When Tuo De Lin died, the Kokand leader Pasha gathered Han and Hui forces from Urumqi, Gucheng, and elsewhere to attack Shashanzi in concert with Bai Yanhu from a distance.

sentences.zh: 景廉急檄孔才嚴備濟木薩各要隘，黑龍江營總依勒和布援沙山子，吉爾洪額等援哈密，而景廉坐鎮古城，飲酒習射，若無事然。

translations.literal: Jing Lian urgently ordered Kong Cai to guard the passes of Jimsar strictly, the Heilongjiang commander E Lei He Bu to relieve Shashanzi, Jir Hong'e and others to relieve Hami, while Jing Lian himself sat at Gucheng drinking wine and practicing archery as if nothing were amiss.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Lian urgently ordered Kong Cai to secure the passes at Jimsar, sent the Heilongjiang commander E Lei He Bu to relieve Shashanzi and Jir Hong'e to relieve Hami, while he himself remained at Gucheng drinking wine and practicing archery as though nothing were wrong.

sentences.zh: 依勒和布與游擊徐學功率騎五百敗賊沙棗園，擒斬無算。

translations.literal: E Lei He Bu and Guerrilla Commander Xu Xuegong led five hundred cavalry to defeat the rebels at Shazao Garden, capturing and killing beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: E Lei He Bu and Guerrilla Commander Xu Xuegong led five hundred horsemen to rout the rebels at Shazao Garden, capturing and killing countless enemy fighters.

sentences.zh: 帕夏遁歸吐魯番，遂解沙山子之圍。

translations.literal: Pasha fled back to Turfan and the siege of Shashanzi was thereby lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Pasha fled back to Turfan, and the siege of Shashanzi was lifted.

sentences.zh: 吉爾洪額等抵巴里坤，連戰皆捷，遂度天山，敗賊哈密泥基頭。

translations.literal: Jir Hong'e and others reached Barkol, won successive battles, crossed the Tianshan, and defeated the rebels at Hami Nijitou.
translations.idiomatic: Jir Hong'e and his forces reached Barkol, won a series of victories, crossed the Tianshan, and defeated the rebels at Hami Nijitou.

sentences.zh: 城中聞援軍至，大呼突出，賊敗，巴里坤肅清。

translations.literal: Hearing relief troops had arrived, the city garrison shouted and sallied forth; the rebels were defeated and Barkol was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: When the garrison heard that relief had arrived, the defenders charged out with a great shout; the rebels were defeated and Barkol was cleared.

sentences.zh: 是役也，論者謂新疆治亂一大關鍵也。

translations.literal: Of this campaign commentators said it was a great turning point in the order and disorder of Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators regarded this campaign as a decisive turning point in whether Xinjiang would remain under Qing control.

sentences.zh: 白彥虎竄唐朝渠，將入瑪納斯，學功偵得賊口號，選精騎四百，偽為瑪納斯人，迎之龔家瀧，握手慰勞，賊不之疑，益前進，前臨大河。

translations.literal: Bai Yanhu fled to Tangcha Qu and was about to enter Manas; Xue Gong learned the rebels' watchword, selected four hundred elite cavalry, posed as men of Manas, welcomed them at Gongjia Long, shook hands and comforted them; the rebels did not suspect and advanced further until they faced a great river.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Yanhu fled toward Tangcha Qu intending to enter Manas; Xue Gong learned the rebels' password, picked four hundred elite horsemen, disguised them as locals from Manas, and met the rebels at Gongjia Long with handshakes and greetings; the enemy suspected nothing and pressed on until they came to a broad river.

sentences.zh: 官軍從後起，賊大驚，白彥虎引四十餘騎逸去，餘盡殲焉。

translations.literal: Government troops rose from behind; the rebels were greatly alarmed; Bai Yanhu fled with a little over forty horsemen and the rest were annihilated.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops sprang up from behind; the rebels panicked; Bai Yanhu escaped with a little more than forty horsemen while the rest were wiped out.

sentences.zh: 學功者，烏魯木齊農家子，沉勇多智略。

translations.literal: Xue Gong was a farmer's son from Urumqi, deep in courage and rich in stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Gong was the son of a farming family near Urumqi, known for steady courage and keen stratagems.

sentences.zh: 軍興，集鄉勇自衛。

translations.literal: When war arose he gathered local braves for self-defense.
translations.idiomatic: When the fighting began he gathered local militia for self-defense.

sentences.zh: 或離合於妥得璘、帕夏之間，為以賊攻賊之計。

translations.literal: At times he shifted between Tuo De Lin and Pasha, using the plan of setting rebels against rebels.
translations.idiomatic: At times he shifted allegiance between Tuo De Lin and Pasha, employing the strategy of setting one rebel force against another.

sentences.zh: 景廉招之來，推誠待之，遂原效死，至是果得其力。

translations.literal: Jing Lian summoned him, treated him with sincerity, and he thereupon pledged to die in service; on this occasion he indeed proved his worth.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Lian brought him in and treated him with complete sincerity; Xue Gong then pledged his life to the cause, and on this occasion proved his value.

sentences.zh: 奏請破格錄用，報可。

translations.literal: A memorial requested his exceptional appointment; approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Lian memorialized for his exceptional appointment to office, and the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 景廉以憂勤致疾，再乞解職，溫旨慰留。

translations.literal: Jing Lian fell ill from worry and diligence, twice begged to resign, and received warm edicts urging him to remain.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Lian fell ill from overwork and anxiety and twice asked to resign, but received warm edicts urging him to stay in office.

sentences.zh: 十三年，授欽差大臣，督辦新疆軍務。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was appointed Imperial Commissioner to supervise Xinjiang military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was appointed Imperial Commissioner to direct military affairs in Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 於是景廉奏請通籌全局，命伊犁將軍金順取道古牧地，提督張曜由天山南取吐魯番，領隊大臣沙克都林札布、錫綸由沙山子取瑪納斯，三路齊舉，使賊不相顧。

translations.literal: Thereupon Jing Lian memorialized for overall planning: order Ili General Jin Shun to advance by way of Gucheng, Brigadier Zhang Yao to take Turfan south of the Tianshan, Brigade Commanders Shakudulin Zhabu and Xilun to take Manas from Shashanzi; the three routes would advance together so the rebels could not attend to one another.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Lian then memorialized for a coordinated campaign: Ili General Jin Shun was to advance by way of Gucheng, Brigadier Zhang Yao to take Turfan from south of the Tianshan, and Brigade Commanders Shakudulin Zhabu and Xilun to strike Manas from Shashanzi, with all three columns moving together so the rebels could not shift forces between fronts.

sentences.zh: 奇台、古城為哈密、巴里坤屏蔽，命副都統額爾慶額、孝順、福珠哩駐西湖，防賊逸入北路。

translations.literal: Qitai and Gucheng shielded Hami and Barkol; he ordered Vice Commanders E'er Qing'e, Xiaoshun, and Fuzhuli to garrison Xihu to prevent rebels slipping into the northern route.
translations.idiomatic: Because Qitai and Gucheng shielded Hami and Barkol, he ordered Vice Commanders E'er Qing'e, Xiaoshun, and Fuzhuli to hold Xihu and block rebel incursions into the northern route.

sentences.zh: 烏魯木齊之南俗呼搭板城者，實通吐魯番要路，賊以重兵守之，宜潛師攻擾以搤其吭。

translations.literal: South of Urumqi the place commonly called Daban Cheng was in fact the vital route to Turfan; rebels held it with heavy troops; he proposed secret attacks to seize their throat.
translations.idiomatic: South of Urumqi lay Daban Cheng, commonly so called, which was in fact the vital route to Turfan; the rebels held it with heavy forces, and he urged covert raids to strike at their jugular.

sentences.zh: 並請飭陝甘總督左宗棠總司後路糧台。

translations.literal: He also requested that Shaanxi-Gansu Governor Zuo Zongtang be ordered to oversee the rear supply depots in general.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that Shaanxi-Gansu Governor Zuo Zongtang be placed in overall charge of rear-area supply depots.

sentences.zh: 移甘肅民千戶實奇台、古城屯田，購蒙古駝數千隻，借撥部款六十萬兩。

translations.literal: He moved a thousand Gansu households to settle and farm at Qitai and Gucheng, purchased several thousand Mongol camels, and borrowed six hundred thousand taels from the ministry.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed resettling a thousand Gansu households to farm at Qitai and Gucheng, purchasing several thousand Mongol camels, and borrowing six hundred thousand taels from the ministry.

sentences.zh: 疏上，悉蒙嘉納，而忌者尼之，未竟所施。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted and all points were commended, but jealous men obstructed it and his plans were not fully carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted and every point won approval, but jealous rivals blocked him and his plans were never fully implemented.

sentences.zh: 改正白旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: He was made General of the Plain White Banner Han Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed General of the Plain White Banner Han Army.

sentences.zh: 俄召回京，遷左都御史。

translations.literal: Soon he was recalled to the capital and promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon recalled to the capital and promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，命入軍機，兼總理各國大臣。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu he was ordered into the Grand Council and concurrently made Minister in charge of affairs of all nations.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Guangxu he entered the Grand Council and was concurrently appointed Minister for Foreign Affairs.

sentences.zh: 授工部尚書，調戶部。

translations.literal: He was made Minister of Works and transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Minister of Works and then transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 坐事降二級，仍留軍機。

translations.literal: For an offense he was demoted two ranks but remained in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: After being implicated in a case he was demoted two ranks but kept his seat on the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 補內閣學士，再遷兵部尚書。

translations.literal: He was made Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat and later promoted again to Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat and later promoted again to Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 時言路尚激烈，或不平，景廉曰：「政府如射之有的，言者期其中耳，於我輩何憾？

translations.literal: At that time remonstrance was still fierce and some were displeased; Jing Lian said: "The government is like the target in archery; speakers only hope to hit the mark—what regret is there for us?
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance was still fierce in those days, and some colleagues took offense; Jing Lian said, "The government is the target in archery, and critics only hope to hit the mark—what is there for us to resent?

sentences.zh: 且詆政府者率無罪，未必非大臣之福也。」

translations.literal: Moreover those who revile the government are usually without fault, and that may not fail to be a blessing for high ministers."
translations.idiomatic: Besides, those who attack the government are usually not guilty of any crime, and their criticism may prove a blessing to senior ministers."

sentences.zh: 人服其量。

translations.literal: People admired his magnanimity.
translations.idiomatic: People admired his breadth of mind.

sentences.zh: 新疆勘定，將軍金順上言景廉前勞，請​​獎勵。

translations.literal: When Xinjiang was pacified, General Jin Shun memorialized Jing Lian's earlier labors and requested rewards.
translations.idiomatic: After Xinjiang was pacified, General Jin Shun memorialized praising Jing Lian's earlier service and asked that he be rewarded.

sentences.zh: 景廉謂邊帥推功樞臣，恐開迎合之漸，請勿許，時論與之。

translations.literal: Jing Lian said that for a frontier commander to push merit onto a Grand Council member might open a gradual path of flattery and asked that it not be granted; public opinion agreed with him.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Lian argued that when frontier commanders pushed credit onto Grand Council members it encouraged flattery and asked that the reward be denied; contemporary opinion sided with him.

sentences.zh: 十年，硃諭景廉循分供職，經濟非所長，降二級調用。

translations.literal: In the tenth year an imperial rescript in vermilion ink said Jing Lian should serve within his station, that economics was not his strength, and he was demoted two ranks and transferred.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year an imperial rescript declared that Jing Lian should keep to his proper duties, that statecraft was not his strength, and he was demoted two ranks and reassigned.

sentences.zh: 明年，補內閣學士。

translations.literal: The next year he was made Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 八月，卒於官，年六十二。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he died in office at the age of sixty-two.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he died in office at the age of sixty-two.

sentences.zh: 子治麟，國子監司業，見孝友傳。

translations.literal: His son Zhilin was Vice Director of the Imperial Academy; see the Biographies of Filial Sons and Friends.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhilin served as Vice Director of the Imperial Academy; see the Biographies of Filial Sons and Friends.

sentences.zh: 額勒和布，字筱山，覺爾察氏，滿洲鑲藍旗人。

translations.literal: E Lei He Bu, style name Xiaoshan, of the Juercha clan, was a man of the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: E Lei He Bu, whose style name was Xiaoshan, was of the Juercha clan and belonged to the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年繙譯進士，改庶吉士，用戶部主事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng he passed the translation jinshi examination, became a Hanlin bachelor, and was appointed a principal secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianfeng he passed the translation jinshi examination, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and was appointed principal secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 累遷理籓院侍郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in succession to Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 同治三年，熱河土默特貝勒旗老頭滋事，額勒和布奉命查辦得實，請將貝勒議處，其佐領、章京等降革有差，事遂定。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tongzhi elders in the Tumed Prince's Banner of Rehe caused trouble; E Lei He Bu was ordered to investigate, found the facts true, requested disciplinary action against the prince, and demoted or dismissed his assistants and clerks in varying degrees; the matter was settled.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tongzhi elders in the Tumed Prince's Banner of Rehe stirred up trouble; E Lei He Bu was ordered to investigate, confirmed the charges, recommended disciplinary action against the prince, and demoted or dismissed his subordinates in varying degrees until the affair was settled.

sentences.zh: 由蒙古副都統調補滿洲。

translations.literal: He was transferred from Mongol vice commander to fill a Manchu post.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred from a Mongol vice commander's post to a Manchu assignment.

sentences.zh: 旋授盛京戶部侍郎，兼奉天府府尹。

translations.literal: He was soon made Vice Minister of Revenue at Mukden and concurrently Prefect of Fengtian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed Vice Minister of Revenue at Mukden and concurrently served as Prefect of Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 直隸總督劉長佑率師防剿熱河及奉天馬賊，額勒和布籌給軍食。

translations.literal: Zhili Governor Liu Changyou led troops to defend and suppress bandits in Rehe and Fengtian; E Lei He Bu arranged military provisions.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhili Governor Liu Changyou led troops against bandits in Rehe and Fengtian, E Lei He Bu organized the supply of rations.

sentences.zh: 賊酋周榮糾黨回竄，擾及昌圖，所在告警。

translations.literal: The rebel chief Zhou Rong gathered followers and fled back, harassing Changtu; alarms sounded everywhere.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel leader Zhou Rong rallied his followers and fled back into the region, raiding as far as Changtu and setting off alarms throughout the territory.

sentences.zh: 額勒和布遣將率馬隊迎擊開原，而以步隊扼其後，賊遂潰散。

translations.literal: E Lei He Bu sent generals with cavalry to meet them at Kaiyuan while infantry blocked their rear; the rebels then broke and scattered.
translations.idiomatic: E Lei He Bu sent cavalry to meet them at Kaiyuan while infantry blocked their retreat, and the rebels broke and scattered.

sentences.zh: 六年，請酌抽鹽釐充練兵經費，增設海防同知駐營口，均議行。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he requested drawing salt levies to fund militia training and adding a coastal defense sub-prefect stationed at Yingkou; both were approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he proposed allocating salt levies to fund militia training and establishing a coastal defense sub-prefect at Yingkou; both proposals were approved.

sentences.zh: 於賑務尤盡力捐募。

translations.literal: In relief work he especially exerted himself in donations and fund-raising.
translations.idiomatic: In famine relief he worked especially hard to raise donations.

sentences.zh: 署盛京將軍，調察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: He acted as General of Mukden and was transferred to Commander at Chahar.
translations.idiomatic: He served as acting General of Mukden and was then transferred to Commander at Chahar.

sentences.zh: 新疆用兵，額勒和布經紀糧運，並調八旗官兵助剿，擢烏里雅蘇台將軍，屢卻悍賊。

translations.literal: During the Xinjiang campaign E Lei He Bu managed grain transport and mobilized Eight Banner troops to assist in suppression; he was promoted to General at Uliastai and repeatedly repelled fierce rebels.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xinjiang campaign he managed grain transport, mobilized Eight Banner troops for the fighting, was promoted to General at Uliastai, and repeatedly repelled fierce rebel forces.

sentences.zh: 光緒三年，因病乞休。

translations.literal: In the third year of Guangxu he begged retirement on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Guangxu he requested retirement because of illness.

sentences.zh: 六年，起鑲白旗漢軍都統，調蒙古。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was recalled as General of the Bordered White Banner Han Army and transferred to Mongolia.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was recalled to serve as General of the Bordered White Banner Han Army and was transferred to Mongolia.

sentences.zh: 歷熱河都統、理籓院尚書、戶部尚書、內務府大臣。

translations.literal: He served in succession as Commander at Rehe, Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, Minister of Revenue, and Grand Minister of the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: He served in succession as Commander at Rehe, Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, Minister of Revenue, and Grand Minister of the Imperial Household Department.

sentences.zh: 十年，命直軍機，協辦大學士。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was ordered to serve on the Grand Council and made Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was appointed to the Grand Council and made Associate Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 奏請允開滇、越邊界礦務，又奏光緒四年以前直省錢漕積欠者，請予蠲免。

translations.literal: He memorialized to permit mining along the Yunnan-Vietnam border and also memorialized that accumulated grain-tax arrears in the provinces before the fourth year of Guangxu be remitted.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to open mining along the Yunnan-Vietnam border and also asked that provincial grain-tax arrears accumulated before the fourth year of Guangxu be remitted.

sentences.zh: 司業潘衍桐建言特開藝學科，以額勒和布持不可，寢其議。

translations.literal: Vice Director Pan Yantong proposed establishing a special examination in technical arts; E Lei He Bu held it impossible and the proposal was shelved.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director Pan Yantong proposed a special civil service examination in technical arts; E Lei He Bu opposed it and the proposal was dropped.

sentences.zh: 十一年，授體仁閣大學士，轉武英殿。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Embodying Benevolence and transferred to the Hall of Military Glory.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Embodying Benevolence and transferred to the Hall of Military Glory.

sentences.zh: 歷充閱卷大臣等差。

translations.literal: He repeatedly served as chief examiner and in other such assignments.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly served as chief examiner and in other such posts.

sentences.zh: 二十年，免直軍機。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was removed from service on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he was removed from the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，致仕。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he retired from office.

sentences.zh: 逾四年，卒於家，諡文恭。

translations.literal: More than four years later he died at home and was given the posthumous title Wengong.
translations.idiomatic: A little more than four years later he died at home and was posthumously titled Wengong.

sentences.zh: 額勒和布木訥寡言，時同列漸攬權納賄，獨廉潔自守，時頗稱之。

translations.literal: E Lei He Bu was dull of speech and sparing of words; at the time his colleagues gradually seized power and accepted bribes, but he alone kept himself pure and was much praised.
translations.idiomatic: E Lei He Bu was a man of few words; while his colleagues gradually seized power and took bribes, he alone remained incorrupt and was widely praised.

sentences.zh: 許庚身，字星叔，浙江仁和人。

translations.literal: Xu Gengshen, style name Xingshu, was a native of Renhe in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Gengshen, whose style name was Xingshu, was a native of Renhe in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 咸豐初，由舉人考取內閣中書。

translations.literal: Early in Xianfeng, as a provincial graduate he passed the examination for Secretariat Drafter in the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Xianfeng reign, as a provincial graduate he passed the examination for Secretariat Drafter in the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 嘗代同官夜直，一夕，票二百簽，署名牘背。

translations.literal: Once he substituted for a colleague on night duty; in one night he handled two hundred memorials, signing his name on the back of each document.
translations.idiomatic: Once, substituting for a colleague on night duty, he processed two hundred memorials in a single night, signing his name on the back of each document.

sentences.zh: 文宗閱本，心識之，以詢侍郎許乃普，乃普為其諸父行也，遂命充軍機章京。

translations.literal: The Wenzong Emperor read the documents and took note of him, inquired of Vice Minister Xu Naipu, who was his father's generation, and then ordered him appointed Grand Council clerk.
translations.idiomatic: The Xianfeng Emperor read the documents, took note of him, and asked Vice Minister Xu Naipu—who was of his father's generation—about him; he was then appointed a Grand Council clerk.

sentences.zh: 故事，大臣子弟不得入直，是命蓋異數雲。

translations.literal: By precedent sons of high ministers were not permitted to enter regular duty; this appointment was an exceptional case.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent the sons of senior ministers were barred from regular Grand Council duty, so this appointment was an exceptional honor.

sentences.zh: 十年，車駕狝木蘭，召赴行在。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, when the imperial carriage hunted at Mulan, he was summoned to the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, when the court was hunting at Mulan, he was summoned to the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 是時肅順方怙權勢，數侵軍機事，高坐直廬，有所撰擬，輒趣章京往屬草。

translations.literal: At that time Su Shun was relying on his power, repeatedly encroaching on Grand Council business, sitting high in the duty hall; when he had something to draft he would hurry a clerk to compose it.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Su Shun was abusing his power and repeatedly encroaching on Grand Council business, sitting imperiously in the duty hall and ordering clerks to draft whatever he dictated.

sentences.zh: 庚身以非制，不許，使者十數至，卒弗應。

translations.literal: Gengshen held it contrary to regulations and refused; messengers came a dozen times and he ultimately did not comply.
translations.idiomatic: Gengshen held that this violated regulations and refused; messengers came more than a dozen times, but he never complied.

sentences.zh: 肅順慚且懟，欲中以危法，未得間。

translations.literal: Su Shun was ashamed and angry, wished to trap him with a capital offense, but found no opportunity.
translations.idiomatic: Su Shun was both ashamed and furious and sought to trap him on a capital charge, but found no opportunity.

sentences.zh: 穆宗纘業，特賜金以旌其風節，命隨大臣入直。

translations.literal: When the Muzong Emperor succeeded, he was specially granted gold to honor his integrity and ordered to enter duty with the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tongzhi Emperor succeeded, he was specially granted gold to honor his integrity and ordered to take regular duty alongside the ministers.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，成進士，自請就本官，補侍讀。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he became a jinshi, requested to keep his original post, and was made Reader.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he passed the jinshi examination, asked to retain his original post, and was appointed Reader.

sentences.zh: 累遷鴻臚寺少卿。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in succession to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 母憂歸，服竟，遷內閣侍讀學士，入直如故。

translations.literal: He returned home for his mother's mourning; when mourning ended he was made Reader in the Grand Secretariat and entered duty as before.
translations.idiomatic: He returned home to observe mourning for his mother; when the mourning period ended he was appointed Reader in the Grand Secretariat and resumed Grand Council duty as before.

sentences.zh: 進春秋屬辭，被嘉獎。

translations.literal: He presented Spring and Autumn Annals: Phrasing and Meaning and received commendation.
translations.idiomatic: He presented his work Spring and Autumn Annals: Phrasing and Meaning and received imperial commendation.

sentences.zh: 補光祿寺卿。

translations.literal: He was made Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 典試貴州，督江西學政，頗以天算、輿地諸學試士。

translations.literal: He presided over the Guizhou examination, supervised education in Jiangxi, and often tested candidates in astronomy, mathematics, geography, and related studies.
translations.idiomatic: He served as chief examiner in Guizhou, supervised education in Jiangxi, and often tested candidates in astronomy, mathematics, geography, and related fields.

sentences.zh: 光緒四年，授太常寺卿。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Guangxu he was made Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Guangxu he was appointed Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 擢禮部侍郎，調戶部、刑部。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Minister of Rites and transferred to Revenue and Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Vice Minister of Rites and later transferred to the ministries of Revenue and Justice.

sentences.zh: 十年，法越事起，充軍機大臣，兼總理各國事務，晉頭品服。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, when the Franco-Vietnamese affair arose, he served as Grand Council minister, concurrently directed foreign affairs, and was advanced to first-rank court dress.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, when the Franco-Vietnamese conflict broke out, he joined the Grand Council, concurrently directed foreign affairs, and was granted first-rank court dress.

sentences.zh: 時樞府孫毓汶最被眷遇，庚身以應對敏練，太后亦信仗之。

translations.literal: At the time Sun Yuwen of the Grand Council enjoyed the greatest favor; Gengshen was nimble in response and the Empress Dowager also relied on him.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Sun Yuwen enjoyed the greatest favor in the Grand Council, but Gengshen's quick and polished responses also won the Empress Dowager's trust.

sentences.zh: 十四年，晉兵部尚書。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was promoted to Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was promoted to Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 十九年，卒，諡恭慎。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he died and was given the posthumous title Gongjin.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he died and was posthumously titled Gongjin.

sentences.zh: 庚身自郎曹至尚侍，直樞垣垂三十年，與兵事相終始，為最久雲。

translations.literal: From a bureau post to minister, Gengshen served at the Grand Council for nearly thirty years, beginning and ending with military affairs—the longest tenure, it is said.
translations.idiomatic: From a bureau post to minister, Gengshen served at the Grand Council for nearly thirty years, spanning the entire course of the military crises of the age—the longest such tenure on record.

sentences.zh: 錢應溥，字子密，浙江嘉興人。

translations.literal: Qian Yingpu, style name Zimi, was a native of Jiaxing in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Yingpu, whose style name was Zimi, was a native of Jiaxing in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 拔貢生，朝考一等，用七品小京官，分吏部，直軍機。

translations.literal: As a selected tribute student he ranked first in the palace examination, was appointed a seventh-rank capital official in the Ministry of Personnel, and served on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: As a selected tribute student he ranked first in the palace examination, was appointed a seventh-rank capital official in the Ministry of Personnel, and served on the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十年，粵寇連陷浙東西郡縣，應溥父海寧州學訓導泰吉，質行樸學，老儒也，時已罷官，州人留主講書院。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xianfeng the Cantonese rebels successively seized eastern and western Zhejiang prefectures and counties; Yingpu's father Taiji, instructor at the Haining prefectural school, was a man of plain conduct and solid learning, an old scholar already dismissed from office whom the people of the prefecture had kept to head the academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Xianfeng the Taiping rebels overran prefectures and counties across eastern and western Zhejiang; Yingpu's father Taiji, a dismissed instructor at the Haining prefectural school and a scholar of plain integrity and solid learning, had been kept by local people to head the academy.

sentences.zh: 應溥聞警，亟請歸奉親，轉徙經年，鬚髮為白。

translations.literal: Hearing the alarm, Yingpu urgently asked to return and care for his father; after wandering for a year his beard and hair turned white.
translations.idiomatic: When he heard the alarm, Yingpu urgently asked leave to return and care for his father; after a year of displacement his hair and beard turned white.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓治兵安慶，招入幕，工為文檄，敏捷如夙構。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan raised troops at Anqing and recruited him to his staff; he was skilled at proclamations and dispatches, swift as if long prepared.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan raised troops at Anqing and recruited him to his staff; he excelled at drafting proclamations and dispatches with the speed of long practice.

sentences.zh: 國籓屢欲特薦，皆力辭。

translations.literal: Guofan repeatedly wished to recommend him for special promotion, but he firmly declined.
translations.idiomatic: Guofan repeatedly sought to recommend him for special promotion, but he firmly declined each time.

sentences.zh: 同治三年，奏加五品卿銜。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tongzhi a memorial added the fifth-rank honorary title of Qing.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tongzhi he was granted the honorary fifth-rank title of Qing by memorial.

sentences.zh: 大軍徵捻，駐周家口。

translations.literal: The main army campaigned against the Nian and was stationed at Zhoujiakou.
translations.idiomatic: When the main army campaigned against the Nian rebels, it was stationed at Zhoujiakou.

sentences.zh: 捻宵至，守卒僅千人，眾駭懼，應溥鎮靜若無事然。

translations.literal: The Nian came at night; the garrison had only a thousand men; the crowd was alarmed, but Yingpu was calm as if nothing were amiss.
translations.idiomatic: When the Nian attacked at night, the garrison had only a thousand men and the troops panicked, but Yingpu remained as calm as if nothing were wrong.

sentences.zh: 於是國籓堅臥不起，捻卒不敢犯。

translations.literal: Thereupon Guofan lay firm and would not rise, and the Nian soldiers did not dare attack.
translations.idiomatic: Guofan then lay firm in bed and refused to stir, and the Nian soldiers did not dare attack.

sentences.zh: 晉四品卿銜，國籓深倚重之，其督兩江，有大興革，上奏辭皆囑應溥具草。

translations.literal: He was advanced to fourth-rank honorary Qing; Guofan relied on him deeply; when he governed the Two Jiangs and undertook major reforms, all memorials and memorials of leave were entrusted to Yingpu to draft.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to fourth-rank honorary Qing; Guofan relied on him heavily, and when Guofan governed the Two Jiangs and undertook major reforms, he entrusted all memorials to Yingpu to draft.

sentences.zh: 光緒初，養親事畢，乃入都，重直軍機，擢員外郎。

translations.literal: Early in Guangxu, when caring for his parents was finished, he entered the capital, resumed Grand Council duty, and was promoted to department director.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Guangxu reign, after completing his filial duties, he returned to the capital, resumed service on the Grand Council, and was promoted to department director.

sentences.zh: 恭忠親王、醇賢親王相繼秉政，皆嘉其諳練。

translations.literal: Prince Gong and Prince Chun successively held power and both praised his experience and skill.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Gong and Prince Chun successively held power, both praised his experience and competence.

sentences.zh: 每承旨繕詔，頃刻千言，曲當上意。

translations.literal: Whenever he received orders to draft edicts he produced a thousand words in moments, fitting the sovereign's intent exactly.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he received orders to draft edicts he could produce a thousand words in moments, fitting the sovereign's intent exactly.

sentences.zh: 累遷禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in succession to Vice Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 偕尚書崑岡按事河南，自巡撫裕寬以下降黜有差。

translations.literal: Together with Minister Kun Gang he investigated affairs in Henan; from Governor Yu Kuan downward demotions and dismissals were imposed in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Minister Kun Gang he investigated affairs in Henan, and officials from Governor Yu Kuan downward were demoted or dismissed in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮事起，廷議主戰，應溥造膝敷陳，多人所不敢言。

translations.literal: When the Korean affair arose court debate favored war; Yingpu went before the throne and set forth his views, saying much that others dared not say.
translations.idiomatic: When the Korean crisis arose and court debate favored war, Yingpu went before the throne and spoke frankly on matters others dared not raise.

sentences.zh: 旋任軍機大臣，再遷工部尚書。

translations.literal: He was soon made a Grand Council minister and later promoted again to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He soon joined the Grand Council and was later promoted again to Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 謝病歸。

translations.literal: He resigned on grounds of illness and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: He resigned because of illness and returned home.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，卒，諡恭勤。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he died and was given the posthumous title Gongqin.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year he died and was posthumously titled Gongqin.

sentences.zh: 子駿祥，翰林院侍讀。

translations.literal: His son Junxiang was a Reader in the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: His son Junxiang served as Reader in the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 廖壽恆，字仲山，江蘇嘉定人。

translations.literal: Liao Shouheng, style name Zhongshan, was a native of Jiading in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Liao Shouheng, whose style name was Zhongshan, was a native of Jiading in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 同治二年進士，授編修。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the second year of Tongzhi, he was made Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: He became a jinshi in the second year of Tongzhi and was appointed Compiler.

sentences.zh: 出督湖南學政。

translations.literal: He went out to supervise education in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out to supervise education in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，再擢侍講。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu he was promoted again to Lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Guangxu he was promoted again to Lecturer.

sentences.zh: 近畿旱災，壽恆應詔陳言，以為：「吏治壞則民情鬱，以其愁苦之氣薄陰陽之和而災祲生，應天以實不以文。

translations.literal: When drought struck the capital region, Shouheng responded to an edict and stated: "When official governance is corrupt the people's feelings are pent up; their anguish thins the harmony of yin and yang and calamities arise; one must respond to Heaven with substance, not with empty words.
translations.idiomatic: When drought struck the capital region, Shouheng responded to an imperial edict, arguing: "When official governance fails, popular discontent builds until the people's anguish disturbs the balance of yin and yang and calamities follow; Heaven must be answered with real deeds, not empty rhetoric.

sentences.zh: 原皇上審敬怠，明是非，覈功罪，信賞罰，勿徒視為具文。」

translations.literal: I pray the Emperor will examine reverence and negligence, clarify right and wrong, assess merit and fault, trust rewards and punishments, and not treat these merely as formal documents."
translations.idiomatic: I pray that Your Majesty will examine who is diligent and who is negligent, distinguish right from wrong, assess merit and fault, enforce rewards and punishments in earnest, and not treat such measures as mere formalities."

sentences.zh: 語甚切至。

translations.literal: The words were very earnest.
translations.idiomatic: His words were remarkably earnest.

sentences.zh: 尋以內務府開支失實，請嚴飭，以為浮濫者戒。

translations.literal: Soon, because the Imperial Household Department's expenditures were false, he requested strict correction as a warning against extravagance.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, because the Imperial Household Department's accounts were false, he asked for strict correction as a warning against waste.

sentences.zh: 再督河南學政，累遷內閣學士，仍留視學。

translations.literal: He again supervised education in Henan, was promoted in succession to Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat, and still retained educational supervision.
translations.idiomatic: He again supervised education in Henan, rose in succession to Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat, and continued to hold his educational post.

sentences.zh: 坐疏察生員欠考，下部議處。

translations.literal: For lax supervision allowing licentiates to miss examinations, the ministry deliberated on punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Because he had been lax in supervising licentiates who missed examinations, the ministry deliberated on disciplinary action.

sentences.zh: 九年，法人侵據越南安定，壽恆疏言：「法以傳教為事，今乃思闢商務，取徑越南。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the French invaded and seized Anding in Vietnam; Shouheng memorialized: "France makes its business missionary work, but now seeks to open commerce and take a route through Vietnam.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the French invaded and seized Anding in Vietnam; Shouheng memorialized: "France began with missionary work, but now seeks to open trade and advance through Vietnam.

sentences.zh: 越固我籓屬，萬無棄而不顧之理。

translations.literal: Vietnam is firmly our tributary; there is absolutely no principle of abandoning it and paying no heed.
translations.idiomatic: Vietnam is firmly our tributary state; we cannot possibly abandon it and look away.

sentences.zh: 臣愚以謂今日有必戰之勢，而後有可和之局。

translations.literal: This foolish subject holds that today there is a situation requiring war, and only afterward can there be grounds for peace.
translations.idiomatic: This humble subject believes that we must first fight when fighting is necessary, and only then can a settlement become possible.

sentences.zh: 李鴻章威望最隆，北洋勁旅，非他人所能統御。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang's prestige is highest; the Beiyang elite troops cannot be commanded by anyone else.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang enjoys the greatest prestige, and the Beiyang elite troops cannot be commanded by anyone else.

sentences.zh: 宜飭鴻章仍回北洋大臣本任，坐鎮天津，以衛畿輔，而飭署督張樹聲還督兩廣。

translations.literal: It is fitting to order Hongzhang to return to his original post as Beiyang Minister, sit at Tianjin to guard the capital region, and order Acting Governor Zhang Shusheng to return to govern the Two Guangs.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang should be ordered back to his original post as Beiyang Minister to hold Tianjin and guard the capital region, while Acting Governor Zhang Shusheng should return to govern the Two Guangs.

sentences.zh: 樹聲忠勇宿將，必能相機進討，以伸保護屬國之義。

translations.literal: Shusheng is a loyal and brave veteran who will surely advance as circumstances permit to uphold the duty of protecting a tributary state.
translations.idiomatic: Shusheng is a loyal and seasoned commander who will surely advance as circumstances allow and uphold our duty to protect a tributary state.

sentences.zh: 兩督臣各還本任，事屬尋常，可不啟外人之疑；

translations.literal: If the two governors each return to their original posts, the matter is ordinary and need not arouse foreigners' suspicions;
translations.idiomatic: If both governors return to their original posts, the move will appear routine and need not arouse foreign suspicion;

sentences.zh: 而進戰退守，能發能收。

translations.literal: yet advancing to fight and retreating to defend, they can strike and also withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: while in advancing to fight or retreating to defend they can strike boldly and withdraw when needed.

sentences.zh: 彼若悔禍，自可轉圜。

translations.literal: If the other side repents its calamity, matters can naturally be turned around.
translations.idiomatic: If the French repent their aggression, negotiations can naturally be reopened.

sentences.zh: 若必併吞越南，則是兵端自彼而開，不得謂為不修鄰好。」

translations.literal: If they insist on swallowing Vietnam, then war will be opened by them and it cannot be said that we failed to cultivate good neighborly relations."
translations.idiomatic: If they insist on swallowing Vietnam, they will have opened hostilities themselves, and we cannot be accused of failing to keep the peace."

sentences.zh: 法越和議成，壽恆复上疏言：「風聞法使至天津，稱越南既議款，因以分界撤兵事要約李鴻章，鴻章拒不允，擬即來都磋商譯署。

translations.literal: When the Franco-Vietnamese peace was concluded, Shouheng again memorialized: "I hear the French envoy has reached Tianjin, saying that since Vietnam has agreed terms, he will press Li Hongzhang on demarcation and troop withdrawal; Hongzhang has refused, and the envoy plans to come to the capital to negotiate at the translation bureau.
translations.idiomatic: After the Franco-Vietnamese peace was concluded, Shouheng memorialized again: "I hear the French envoy has reached Tianjin and, claiming that Vietnam has already agreed terms, intends to press Li Hongzhang on demarcation and troop withdrawal; Hongzhang has refused, and the envoy plans to come to the capital to negotiate at the translation bureau.

sentences.zh: 論者謂當虛與委蛇。

translations.literal: Commentators say one should temporize and stall.
translations.idiomatic: Some advisers say we should temporize and stall.

sentences.zh: 不知法據越南，去我之屬國；

translations.literal: They do not realize that France holds Vietnam and has taken away our tributary state;
translations.idiomatic: They fail to see that France now holds Vietnam and has stripped us of a tributary state;

sentences.zh: 逐黑旗，撤我之籓籬；

translations.literal: driven out the Black Flag and removed our frontier barrier;
translations.idiomatic: driven out the Black Flag and removed our frontier barrier;

sentences.zh: 通紅江，奪我滇江之大利。

translations.literal: opened the Red River and seized the great profit of our Yunnan river trade.
translations.idiomatic: opened the Red River and seized the great commercial advantage of our Yunnan river trade.

sentences.zh: 先機已失，不可不圖挽回。

translations.literal: The first opportunity is already lost; we cannot fail to plan recovery.
translations.idiomatic: We have already lost the initiative and must plan to recover it.

sentences.zh: 為今之計，直宜以欺陵小弱之罪，佈告列邦，折以公法，令改削所立條約。

translations.literal: For the present plan, we should directly announce to all nations the crime of bullying the small and weak, refute them by international law, and order revision of the treaties they have imposed.
translations.idiomatic: Our present course should be to announce to all nations France's crime of bullying a weak state, invoke international law against them, and demand revision of the treaties they imposed.

sentences.zh: 河內、安定，一律讓還，然後緩議法越通商之約。

translations.literal: Hanoi and Anding should all be returned, and only then should Franco-Vietnamese trade agreements be discussed at leisure.
translations.idiomatic: Hanoi and Anding must be returned in full, and only then should Franco-Vietnamese trade agreements be discussed.

sentences.zh: 現聞津海防務，已飭備嚴整，軍容改觀。

translations.literal: It is now heard that Tianjin coastal defenses have been ordered strictly prepared and military appearance has changed.
translations.idiomatic: I hear that Tianjin's coastal defenses have been ordered into strict readiness and that the army's appearance has greatly improved.

sentences.zh: 臣謂仍當選派知兵大員，率兵輪駛赴越都，以觀動靜。

translations.literal: This subject holds that we should still select a military expert, lead gunboats to the Vietnamese capital, and observe developments.
translations.idiomatic: I believe we should still select an experienced military commander, send gunboats to the Vietnamese capital, and observe developments on the ground.

sentences.zh: 又飛檄廣西防軍援助劉永福，增兵制械，迅拔河內，以扼敵衝。

translations.literal: Also urgently order Guangxi frontier troops to aid Liu Yongfu, increase troops and manufacture arms, swiftly take Hanoi, and choke the enemy's thrust.
translations.idiomatic: We should also urgently order Guangxi frontier troops to aid Liu Yongfu, increase forces and arms production, swiftly take Hanoi, and block the enemy's advance.

sentences.zh: 河內既下，北圻乃安。

translations.literal: Once Hanoi is taken, Tonkin will be secure.
translations.idiomatic: Once Hanoi falls, Tonkin will be secure.

sentences.zh: 蓋我不與法構兵，永福不能不為越守土，故邇來陰助黑旗，屢戰皆捷。

translations.literal: Because we do not fight France openly, Yongfu cannot but defend Vietnamese territory; hence of late we have secretly aided the Black Flag and they have won repeated victories.
translations.idiomatic: Because we have not openly fought France, Yongfu has had no choice but to defend Vietnamese territory; hence our recent secret aid to the Black Flag, which has won repeated victories.

sentences.zh: 法人不得已，乃託言保護。

translations.literal: The French, having no alternative, then pleaded protection as their pretext.
translations.idiomatic: The French, left with no alternative, then pleaded protection as their pretext.

sentences.zh: 永福忿懣填胸，苟奉詔書，無不一以當百。

translations.literal: Yongfu's breast is filled with indignation; if he receives an imperial edict, each man will fight as a hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Yongfu is filled with indignation; if he receives an imperial edict, his men will fight one as a hundred.

sentences.zh: 如此，則滇、粵之邊患稍紓，越、法之兵端可戢。」

translations.literal: Thus the border troubles of Yunnan and Guangdong may be slightly eased and the military clash between Vietnam and France may be quelled."
translations.idiomatic: In this way the border troubles of Yunnan and Guangdong may be eased and the fighting between Vietnam and France brought to an end."

sentences.zh: 壽恆又以：「根本之計，責在宸躬。

translations.literal: Shouheng also stated: "The fundamental plan rests on the sovereign's own person.
translations.idiomatic: Shouheng also wrote: "The fundamental remedy lies with the sovereign himself.

sentences.zh: 跬步不離正人，乃可薰陶德性。

translations.literal: Not leaving upright men for a single step is how moral character can be nurtured.
translations.idiomatic: Only by keeping upright men at his side at every step can moral character be nurtured.

sentences.zh: 擬請皇太后、皇上，御前太監務取厚重樸實之人，其有年紀太輕、性情浮動者，屏勿使近。

translations.literal: I propose asking the Empress Dowager and Emperor that eunuchs before the throne must be grave and plain men; those too young in years or light in temperament should be barred from approaching.
translations.idiomatic: I propose that the Empress Dowager and Emperor choose only grave and steady eunuchs for attendance at court and bar from proximity those who are too young or temperamentally flighty.

sentences.zh: 並請懿旨時加訓飭，凡一切淺俗委瑣之言，勿許達於宸聽。

translations.literal: I also ask that imperial instructions admonish from time to time that all shallow, vulgar, and trivial speech be forbidden to reach the sovereign's ears.
translations.idiomatic: I also ask that imperial instructions regularly admonish that shallow, vulgar, and trivial speech must never reach the sovereign's ears.

sentences.zh: 庶幾深宮居息，無往非崇德之端，或可補毓慶宮課程所不及。

translations.literal: Then perhaps life in the inner palace, in every aspect, will be an occasion for honoring virtue and may supplement what the Yuqing Palace curriculum cannot reach.
translations.idiomatic: Then life in the inner palace may become at every turn an occasion for cultivating virtue and may supplement what the Yuqing Palace curriculum cannot provide.

sentences.zh: 至於宮廷土木之工，內府傳辦之件，事屬尋常，最易導引侈念。

translations.literal: As for palace construction and items ordered through the inner household, though ordinary matters, they most easily lead to extravagant thoughts.
translations.idiomatic: As for palace construction and items ordered through the inner household, though ordinary matters, they most easily encourage extravagance.

sentences.zh: 伏原皇太后崇儉黜奢，時以民生為念，俾皇上知稼穡之艱難，目染耳濡，聖功自懋。

translations.literal: I humbly pray the Empress Dowager will honor frugality and reject luxury, keep the people's livelihood in mind, and enable the Emperor to know the hardship of farming; through daily sight and hearing his sage achievement will naturally flourish.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly pray that the Empress Dowager will honor frugality, reject luxury, keep the people's livelihood in mind, and teach the Emperor the hardship of farming; through daily example his sage virtue will naturally flourish.

sentences.zh: 如是，則慈闈教育，更勝於典樂命夔。」

translations.literal: If so, then the mother's instruction will surpass the Director of Music appointing Kui."
translations.idiomatic: In this way the Empress Dowager's instruction will surpass even the ancient appointment of Kui as Director of Music."

sentences.zh: 疏入，上為之動容。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, the sovereign was visibly moved.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was submitted, the sovereign was visibly moved.

sentences.zh: 十年，行走總理衙門。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, he served as a walker at the Office for Managing Affairs of All Nations.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of his career he served in the Zongli Yamen (Foreign Affairs Office).

sentences.zh: 遷兵部侍郎，調禮部、戶部、吏部侍郎，屢典試事。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Minister of War, then to Vice Ministers of Rites, Revenue, and Personnel, and repeatedly presided over examinations.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Vice Minister of War and served successively as Vice Minister of Rites, Revenue, and Personnel, presiding repeatedly over the civil examinations.

sentences.zh: 偕都御史裕德查辦四川鹽務，劾罷鹽茶道蔡逢年，遣戍。

translations.literal: Together with Censor-in-Chief Yude he investigated Sichuan salt affairs, impeached and removed Salt and Tea Circuit Intendant Cai Fengnian, and sent him into exile.
translations.idiomatic: With Censor-in-Chief Yude he investigated Sichuan salt administration, impeached Salt and Tea Circuit Intendant Cai Fengnian, stripped him of office, and banished him.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，遷左都御史，入軍機。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief and entered the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he became Left Censor-in-Chief and entered the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 明年，調禮部尚書。

translations.literal: The following year he was transferred to Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was appointed Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 太后訓政，命出軍機。

translations.literal: When the Empress Dowager resumed political instruction, he was ordered to leave the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: When the Empress Dowager resumed regency, he was ordered to leave the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 以疾乞休。

translations.literal: On account of illness he requested retirement.
translations.idiomatic: He requested retirement on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twenty-ninth year.

sentences.zh: 榮慶，字華卿，鄂卓爾氏，蒙古正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Rong Qing, styled Huaqing, of the Ozhuo'er clan, a Mongol of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Rong Qing, styled Huaqing, of the Ozhuo'er clan, was a Mongol bannerman of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 光緒九年，會試中式。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Guangxu he passed the metropolitan examination.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 9 he passed the metropolitan examination.

sentences.zh: 十二年，成進士，以編修充鑲藍旗管學官。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he became a jinshi and, as Compiler, served as educational officer for the Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 12 he received his jinshi degree and, as a Hanlin Compiler, served as educational officer for the Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 累遷至侍讀學士、蒙古學士。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Reader-in-Waiting and Mongol Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive promotions to Reader-in-Waiting and Mongol Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 遷轉遲滯，榮慶當引見，或諷以乞假，謝曰：「窮達命也，欺君可乎？」

translations.literal: His advancement was slow; when Rong Qing was due for audience, some hinted he should beg leave; he declined, saying: "Advancement and setback are fate—how can one deceive one's lord?"
translations.idiomatic: Promotions came slowly; when his audience was due some suggested he request leave, but he refused: "Fortune and obscurity are ordained—how could I deceive the throne?"

sentences.zh: 居三年，擢鴻臚卿，轉通政副使。

translations.literal: After three years in post he was elevated to Director of Banquets and transferred to Vice Commissioner of the Communications Office.
translations.idiomatic: After three years he was promoted Director of Banquets, then Vice Commissioner of the Communications Office.

sentences.zh: 簡山東學政，丁母憂。

translations.literal: He was selected Shandong education commissioner and entered mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed Shandong education commissioner, he then withdrew for mourning upon his mother's death.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，擢大理卿，署倉場侍郎。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he was elevated to Director of the Court of Judicial Review and acted as Vice Minister in charge of granaries.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 27 he became Director of the Court of Judicial Review and acted as Vice Minister overseeing the grain depots.

sentences.zh: 以剝船盜米，改由火車迳運，並倉廒，增經費，杜領米弊端，裁稽查倉務御史，皆如所請行。

translations.literal: Because grain was stripped from boats and stolen, he changed transport to direct rail shipment, consolidated granaries, increased funds, stopped abuses in grain collection, and cut the censorate posts inspecting granary affairs—all carried out as requested.
translations.idiomatic: To stop boat stripping and grain theft he shifted transport to direct rail delivery, consolidated granaries, increased funding, closed loopholes in grain collection, and eliminated censorate inspectors of granary affairs—all approved and enacted.

sentences.zh: 和議成，奉命會辦善後事宜，兼政務處提調。

translations.literal: When the peace settlement was concluded he was ordered to joint management of post-settlement affairs and also served as coordinator at the Office of Government Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: After the peace settlement he was assigned to joint management of postwar recovery and made coordinator at the Office of Government Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，授刑部尚書。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was appointed Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 28 he was appointed Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 大學堂之創立也，命榮慶副張百熙為管學大臣。

translations.literal: When the Imperial University was founded, Rong Qing was ordered to assist Zhang Baixi as Superintendent of Studies.
translations.idiomatic: When the Imperial University was founded, Rong Qing was appointed to assist Zhang Baixi as Superintendent of Studies.

sentences.zh: 百熙一意更新，榮慶時以舊學調濟之。

translations.literal: Baixi pressed single-mindedly for renewal; Rong Qing frequently tempered him with the old learning.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Baixi pushed relentlessly for reform; Rong Qing often balanced him with the classical tradition.

sentences.zh: 尋充會試副考官、經濟特科閱卷大臣。

translations.literal: Soon after he served as associate examiner for the metropolitan examination and as reviewing minister for the special economic examinations.
translations.idiomatic: He soon served as associate metropolitan examiner and as chief examiner for the special examinations in practical statecraft.

sentences.zh: 調禮部尚書，復調戶部。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Minister of Rites, then again to Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Minister of Rites, then to Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 拜軍機大臣、政務大臣。

translations.literal: He received appointment as Grand Councilor and Minister of Government Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Grand Councilor and Minister of Government Affairs.

sentences.zh: 榮慶既入政地，尤汲汲於厲人才，厚風俗。

translations.literal: Once Rong Qing entered the seat of government he was especially eager to advance talent and enrich custom.
translations.idiomatic: Once in high office Rong Qing was especially zealous to cultivate talent and shore up public morals.

sentences.zh: 嘗疏陳：「國家取才，滿、漢並重。

translations.literal: He once memorialized: "The state draws talent from Manchu and Han alike with equal weight.
translations.idiomatic: He once submitted a memorial: "The state draws talent from Manchu and Han alike with equal importance.

sentences.zh: 請飭下閣部，將所屬滿員嚴加考試，設館課之：一、掌故之學，二、吏治之學，三、時務之學。

translations.literal: He asked that the ministries be ordered to subject their Manchu subordinates to strict examination and establish lecture halls: first, studies in precedent; second, studies in administration; third, studies in current affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He requested that the ministries rigorously examine their Manchu officials and establish lecture halls in three subjects: institutional precedent, administrative practice, and current affairs.

sentences.zh: 尤以御制勸善要言、人臣儆心錄、性理精義、上諭八旗諸書，為居官立身之大本。

translations.literal: Above all he took Imperial Exhortations on Doing Good, Record of Officials' Self-Warning, Essentials of Neo-Confucian Principle, and Imperial Instructions to the Eight Banners as the great foundations for holding office and establishing one's person.
translations.idiomatic: He especially named the Imperial Exhortations on Doing Good, Record of Officials' Self-Warning, Essentials of Principle, and Imperial Instructions to the Eight Banners as the foundations of official conduct.

sentences.zh: 均令分門學習，劄記大綱，以覘其才識。」

translations.literal: All were ordered to study by section, compose outline notes, and thereby gauge their talent and insight."
translations.idiomatic: All were to study these by section, submit outline notes, and thereby reveal their capacity and judgment."

sentences.zh: 疏入，報聞。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, acknowledgment was returned.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was received and noted.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，協辦大學士。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year he became Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year he was appointed Associate Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 是冬，改學部尚書。

translations.literal: That winter he was transferred to Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he became Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 明年，充修訂官制大臣。

translations.literal: The following year he served as Commissioner for Revising the Administrative System.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was appointed Commissioner for Administrative Reform.

sentences.zh: 尋罷軍機，專理部務。

translations.literal: Soon he was removed from the Grand Council and devoted himself solely to ministry affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon removed from the Grand Council and devoted himself solely to his ministry.

sentences.zh: 德宗上賓，充恭辦喪禮大臣。

translations.literal: When the Guangxu Emperor ascended as guest on high, he served as Commissioner for the Funeral Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Upon the death of the Guangxu Emperor he served as Commissioner for the Funeral Rites.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，以疾乞休，溫旨慰留。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong, on account of illness he requested retirement; a gracious edict urged him to remain.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1 he requested retirement on grounds of illness; the throne issued a gracious edict urging him to stay.

sentences.zh: 調禮部尚書。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was reassigned as Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 孝欽後奉安，充隨入地宮大臣，恭點神牌，晉太子少保。
